lines: Gaza war The Israeli army launches its first military operation in central Gaza Strip amid the displacement of families from the area, for the first time since the ceasefire agreement signed in October 2025 came into effect. (BBC)

Aftermath of the July Uprising Two Bangladesh Nationalist Party members are killed when suspected members of the banned Awami League attack a motorcycle procession in Kalia, Narail District, Bangladesh. (Daily Sun)

In Bangladesh, a crowd allegedly led by Chatra Dal members storms and sets fire to the residence of former Awami League Member of Parliament Shamim Osman in Fatullah, Narayanganj District, while unidentified attackers in Nazirpur, Pirojpur District, loot and set fire to two houses belonging to former Minister of Fisheries and Livestock and Awami League leader SM Rezaul Karim, and a crowd in Sirajganj vandalises the local Awami League office and the residence of former MP Habibe Millat. (Views Bangladesh) (The Daily Star)

In Gopalganj District, Bangladesh, armed members of the banned Awami League, Chhatra League, and Jubo League detonate crude bombs and set fire to a private clinic owned by BNP Member of Parliament K M Babar of Gopalganj-2, forcing patients to evacuate. Attackers also burn at least five BNP offices across Muksudpur and Kashiani and target two Grameen Bank branches. (Dhaka Tribune)

Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir A militant commander is killed by the Indian Armed Forces at a mosque in Kulgam district, Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir, after escaping a shootout with troops two days earlier in a neighboring village, where his associate was killed. (AP)

Haitian conflict Salvadoran military intervention in Haiti Salvadoran forces destroy a house belonging to Jeff Larose, the leader of the Taliban gang that operates in Canaan. The Gang Suppression Force says it was not involved. (AP)

2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests In Gazipur, Savar, and Ashulia, Bangladesh, thousands of garment workers demanding a monthly minimum wage increase from ৳12,500 (US$100) to ৳30,000 ($240) block the Dhaka–Mymensingh Highway and set fire to a police vehicle, causing police to fire tear gas and stun grenades in Gazipur and Ashulia as 55 factories close across the three areas, while police report around 300 arrests across 24 cases filed in Savar and Ashulia during the protests. (The Daily Star)

In Kafrul, Dhaka, police fire around ten stun grenades against demonstrating garment workers following clashes with Bangladesh Nationalist Party activists who allegedly harassed female factory employees, causing workers to stage demonstrations and halt production at several nearby garment factories. (The Business Standard)
Arsonists set fire to the ancestral home of Nobel laureate and former chief adviser Muhammad Yunus in Panchlaish, Chattogram, Bangladesh. (The Daily Star)
NASA's space probe Voyager 1 reaches the distance of one light-day from Earth, being the first man-made object to reach that distance, after it launched in 1977. (CNN)
